description: This file contains an HTML webpage demonstrating the merge view feature of the CodeMirror library, including setup and interaction scripts.

methods.name: initUI
methods.description: Initializes and creates the merge view UI with the current configuration.

methods.name: toggleDifferences
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of differences in the merge view.

methods.name: mergeViewHeight
methods.description: Calculates and returns the maximum height among the merge view's editors.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Adjusts the size of the merge view's editors to match the maximum height for consistent UI.
